caption: The drawing depicts the interior hallway of a house with a staircase ascending toward the background, positioned centrally beneath an ornate arch supported by two columns with decorative capitals. The walls are covered in light beige or tan patterned wallpaper with white trim and moldings. On the left side of the hallway, a dark wooden sideboard or console table sits against the wall, accompanied by two chairs with curved, reddish-brown legs and backrests, and striped upholstered seats. Above the table is a large, round, gold-framed mirror with a decorative eagle perched on top, and two crystal wall sconces are mounted on either side of the mirror. The floor is covered by a long, dark-colored runner rug with intricate floral patterns in shades of red, gold, green, and blue, which extends from the foreground toward the base of the stairs and continues along the upper hallway. Further into the hallway, near the back, there is a small, round pedestal table against the wall, topped with a vase or pitcher. The light in the scene appears diffuse, with the entire composition rendered in soft, muted colors.
title: Cutting House (NYC)
